tagline: The global leader in advanced safety products, technology and solutions.
hero_kpi_rationale: The deployment and growth of the MSA+ ecosystem (hardware, software and services) are a key driver for generating recurring revenue and simplifying safety operations, representing a strategic evolution for the company

kpis.name: MSA+ ecosystem revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the integrated offering of hardware, software and safety services.
kpis.description: The MSA+ ecosystem aims to simplify safety operations for customers while creating a source of recurring revenue for MSA. This integrated approach combines hardware, software and services to provide a complete solution to customers.
kpis.signal: Driver of recurring revenue and customer retention.

kpis.name: Net sales
kpis.explanation: Total sales of company products and services.
kpis.description: Consolidated net sales totaled $1,874.8 million for the year ended December 31, 2025, an increase of 3.7% compared to the prior year ($1,808.1 million).

kpis.name: Americas net sales
kpis.explanation: Sales generated in the North America and Latin America regions.
kpis.description: The Americas segment, the largest, recorded sales of $1,261.8 million in 2025, up 1.2% from $1,246.6 million in 2024, primarily driven by organic growth of 0.5%, supported by double-digit growth in detection and a slight increase in personal protective equipment, partially offset by a decline in fire service.
kpis.signal: Limited organic growth in the core segment.

kpis.name: International net sales
kpis.explanation: Sales generated in the Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific regions.
kpis.description: The International segment recorded sales of $613.0 million in 2025, up 9.2% from $561.5 million in 2024, supported by the M C TechGroup acquisition and organic growth of 1.4% in markets such as China and Europe, driven by growth in detection.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by acquisitions and key markets.

kpis.name: Gross profit
kpis.explanation: Profit after deduction of direct production costs.
kpis.description: Gross profit totaled $871.1 million in 2025, up 1.2% from $860.4 million in 2024. Gross margin declined to 46.5% of net sales in 2025 from 47.6% in 2024, primarily due to inflation, foreign exchange headwinds, tariffs and amortization related to the M C acquisition, partially offset by price realization and productivity improvements.
kpis.signal: Gross margin under pressure from inflation and tariffs, despite price realization.

kpis.name: Research and development expenses
kpis.explanation: Expenses dedicated to research and development of new products and solutions.
kpis.description: The company invested $65.3 million in research and development in 2025, down 1.8% from $66.5 million in 2024, representing 3.5% of net sales. Total software development and R&D expenses were $80.2 million, including $14.9 million in capitalized software costs. MSA remains committed to research and development activities, investing a significant portion of new product development in technology solutions.
kpis.signal: Continued commitment to innovation and technology solutions development.

kpis.name: Corporate expenses
kpis.explanation: General and administrative costs not allocated to operating segments.
kpis.description: Corporate expenses totaled $43.4 million in 2025, down 13.6% from $50.4 million in 2024. This reduction is primarily attributable to decreased professional services fees, variable compensation and other discretionary expenses, partially offset by inflation.
kpis.signal: Effective cost reduction in corporate overhead through discretionary expense management.

kpis.name: M C TechGroup acquisition
kpis.explanation: Cost of the acquisition of M C TechGroup and its affiliates, a provider of critical gas analysis systems.
kpis.description: The acquisition of M C TechGroup and its affiliates for $189 million (net of cash acquired), closed on May 6, 2025, strengthens MSA's offering in gas analysis systems for critical environments. M C's portfolio includes systems and solutions for gas sampling, gas conditioning and advanced process control. During the period, M C contributed $13.0 million to Americas sales and $27.9 million to International sales.
kpis.signal: Strategic expansion into gas analysis for critical environments.

kpis.name: Americas organic sales growth
kpis.explanation: Variation in organic sales in the Americas segment, excluding foreign exchange and acquisition effects.
kpis.description: Organic sales growth in the Americas reached 0.5% in 2025. This increase was driven by double-digit growth in detection and a slight increase in industrial personal protective equipment, but partially offset by a decline in fire service due to changes in AFG funding and impacts from the 2025 US federal government shutdown.
kpis.signal: Modest organic growth in the core market despite macroeconomic headwinds.

kpis.name: International organic sales growth
kpis.explanation: Variation in organic sales in the International segment, excluding foreign exchange and acquisition effects.
kpis.description: Organic sales growth in the International segment reached 1.4% in 2025. This increase was primarily driven by growth in detection, particularly in China and Europe, as well as a slight increase in industrial personal protective equipment, partially offset by a modest decline in fire service due to budget changes in key European markets.
kpis.signal: Moderate organic growth driven by detection in China and Europe, despite regional market headwinds.
